# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

**Prerequisite:** `map` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

Run `firecrawl map --help` for the full option list (sitemap handling, subdomains, etc.).

**Done when:** the URL list is saved under `.firecrawl/` and you have selected the URLs to scrape or crawl next.

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)
- [firecrawl-build-search](https://github.com/firecrawl/skills/tree/main/skills/build/firecrawl-build-search) — building URL discovery into an app instead of running it here

The sidebar of the live docs lists 25 pages under `/docs/middleware/builtin/`. I took the list from there. I wrote the one-line descriptions from what I know of each middleware and didn't open every page, so check the newer ones (Method Not Allowed, Mount, Language) against their pages.

| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| [basic-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/basic-auth) | Protects routes with HTTP Basic Authentication (username and password). |
| [bearer-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/bearer-auth) | Authenticates requests using a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. |
| [body-limit](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/body-limit) | Rejects requests whose body is larger than a size you set. |
| [cache](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cache) | Caches responses using the Web Cache API (for example on Cloudflare Workers or Deno). |
| [combine](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/combine) | Combines several middleware into one, using helpers like `some`, `every` and `except`. |
| [compress](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/compress) | Compresses response bodies with gzip or deflate. |
| [context-storage](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/context-storage) | Stores the request `Context` in `AsyncLocalStorage` so you can read it outside handlers with `getContext()`. |
| [cors](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cors) | Adds Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers and handles preflight requests. |
| [csrf](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/csrf) | Guards against CSRF attacks by checking the request's origin and content type. |
| [etag](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/etag) | Adds ETag headers and returns 304 Not Modified for conditional requests. |
| [ip-restriction](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/ip-restriction) | Allows or blocks requests based on the client IP address or range. |
| [jsx-renderer](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jsx-renderer) | Lets you set a JSX layout and render pages through `c.render()`. |
| [jwk](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwk) | Verifies JWTs against a JSON Web Key set, which can be fetched from a remote JWKS URL. |
| [jwt](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwt) | Verifies JSON Web Tokens and rejects requests without a valid one. |
| [logger](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/logger) | Logs each request and response with its method, path, status and elapsed time. |
| [language](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/language) | Detects the user's language from the query string, cookie or `Accept-Language` header. |
| [method-not-allowed](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-not-allowed) | Returns 405 Method Not Allowed when a path matches a route but not the HTTP method. |
| [method-override](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-override) | Lets a request override its HTTP method, for example a form POST acting as PUT or DELETE. |
| [mount](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/mount) | Mounts another framework's fetch-style app (any handler that takes a `Request`) under a path prefix. |
| [pretty-json](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/pretty-json) | Pretty-prints JSON responses when the request includes `?pretty`. |
| [request-id](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/request-id) | Generates a unique ID for each request and sets it in a response header. |
| [secure-headers](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/secure-headers) | Sets security headers such as CSP, HSTS and X-Frame-Options, similar to Helmet. |
| [timeout](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timeout) | Aborts a request with a timeout error if the handler runs longer than a set time. |
| [timing](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timing) | Adds `Server-Timing` headers so you can see timing metrics in browser dev tools. |
| [trailing-slash](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/trailing-slash) | Redirects URLs to add or remove the trailing slash. |

The same sidebar links to `/docs/middleware/third-party`, which is outside the built-in section.
